# Security policy

Please report security issues privately, not in a public issue.

Use **Report a vulnerability** on the
[Security tab](https://github.com/siiway/ui/security/advisories/new), with:

- the package and version affected;
- steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept;
- the impact, and a fix if you have one.

Only the maintainers and you can see the report. Please keep the details
private until a fixed version is published with its advisory.

Fixes go into the latest release.
